An '''unidentified [[Bartender droid/Legends|bartender droid]]''' operated at the [[Cluster]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] circa [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]]. It appeared to be a modified [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] with a tankard of [[Ale/Legends|ale]] attached to the back of its gray, weathered chassis. It dispensed ale from its fingers, connected by a series of tubes to the tankard.

Another similar-looking protocol droid, sans tankard, served at the establishment.
